hero.heading: Windshield Replacement in Boulder City, NV
hero.note: Chip or small crack? Start with chip repair. We do that here, in our own shop. See windshield chip repair.
hero.intro: Chip repair is the job we do ourselves, in our own shop, and when the damage allows it, it can save you a replacement. If the damage is too large to repair safely, we arrange the replacement for you. The glass is ordered to your vehicle's VIN, so the curve, the tint band along the top edge and the sensor mounts match what the manufacturer built. The job is booked, finished on the day of your appointment, and installed by a glass specialist we work with. We help you file the insurance claim, and you deal with one shop from the first call: one call, one point of contact. We serve Boulder City, Henderson and Las Vegas drivers alike. One thing to know before you call: we do not keep windshields in stock. Your glass is ordered in for your specific vehicle, so the appointment is booked for after it arrives, not for the day you ring us. That is usually within the week, a little longer over a weekend.
